entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3868491612036282752: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.6354 +/- 0.0285 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 130.97 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 67.414, -46.284 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.29 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Thomas et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5108 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract). Mass 1.1 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Thomas et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5108 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A.143T/abstract). Temperature 5808 +/- 40 K from Thomas et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5108 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,808 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff1eb. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,808 K and log g 4.26 (u1 0.450, u2 0.265): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
